entities.name: Query c-di-GMP synthase
observations: 365 aa; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt P0DUE2.
Predicted molecular weight 42,352.9 Da and theoretical pI 8.07.
Pfam CD_NTase_C domain detected at residues 242-334.
Curated annotation identifies a CBASS cyclic nucleotide synthase producing c-di-GMP.
Catalyzes 2 GTP -> 3',3'-c-di-GMP + 2 diphosphate; EC 2.7.7.65; Rhea RHEA:24898.

entities.name: P0DUE2
observations: Reviewed Swiss-Prot c-di-GMP synthase from a Flavobacteriaceae sp. CBASS system.
Annotated as a type I-D(GG) CBASS cyclic nucleotide synthase involved in antiphage defense.
Reported to have specificity for c-di-GMP among tested NTP substrates.

entities.name: Type I-D(GG) CBASS
observations: Cyclic nucleotide signaling antiphage defense system in which the synthase-generated second messenger activates effectors that promote abortive phage infection.
